meaning: younger female cousin (mother’s side / aunt’s daughter)
usage: The word '表妹' is used to refer to a younger female cousin on your mother's side.
'表妹' is a noun, so it can be used as the subject or object in a sentence.
When talking about family members, '表妹' helps specify which cousin you are referring to, especially to distinguish from paternal cousins.
You can add possessive markers like '我嘅表妹' to say 'my younger female cousin on my mother's side.'
Use '見' (gin3) or '約' (joek3) with '表妹' to say you meet or arrange to meet your cousin.
